content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Attached is a segment from two ladder diagram programs used in a network of two [product_name] modules. A button on [product_name] 1 sends a signal over the network to activate output Q1 on [product_name] 2, which works as intended. However, I also need to transmit a value in the range of 0 to 1000 from [product_name] 1 to the analog output AQ1 on [product_name] 2. I am unable to achieve this, likely due to unfamiliarity with the correct settings in the "Remote Properties" section. Any assistance would be appreciated! Thank you!
Refer to the provided screenshot. VW0 in [product_name] corresponds to Modbus Holding Register HR1.
That solved my problem! Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focused on networking two [product_name] modules to exchange an analog value. While digital communication worked easily, transferring an analog value (0–1000) was challenging due to unclear configuration in the 'Remote Properties' menu. With guidance from another user on how to map the value using Modbus Holding Registers, the original issue was quickly resolved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks clear and simple guidance for configuring analog value transmission between two networked [product_name] modules, aiming for it to be as straightforward as digital signal exchange.
